from pathlib import Path


def replace_once(path: Path, old: str, new: str) -> None:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"PATCH_ANCHOR_COUNT:{path}:{count}")
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")


contract = Path("scripts/validate_sequence_contract.py")
replace_once(
    contract,
    '''    ap.add_argument("--session", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--report", default="")
    args = ap.parse_args()
''',
    '''    ap.add_argument("--session", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--report", default="")
    ap.add_argument("--no-write-report", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
''',
)
replace_once(
    contract,
    '''    report_path_text = args.report or str(session.get("acceptance_report", "")).strip()
    if report_path_text:
''',
    '''    report_path_text = "" if args.no_write_report else (args.report or str(session.get("acceptance_report", "")).strip())
    if report_path_text:
''',
)

sessions = Path("scripts/validate_sequence_sessions.py")
replace_once(
    sessions,
    '''import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import sys
''',
    '''import argparse
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
''',
)
replace_once(
    sessions,
    '''    results = []
    failed = 0

    for session in sessions:
''',
    '''    results = []
    failed = 0
    child_env = os.environ.copy()
    child_env["PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE"] = "1"

    for session in sessions:
''',
)
replace_once(
    sessions,
    '''                "--session",
                rel,
            ],
            cwd=root,
            text=True,
''',
    '''                "--session",
                rel,
                "--no-write-report",
            ],
            cwd=root,
            env=child_env,
            text=True,
''',
)

workflow = Path(".github/workflows/governance-selftest.yml")
replace_once(
    workflow,
    '''      - name: Project Truth Compiler self-test
        run: python scripts/selftest_project_truth_compiler.py

      - name: STRICT workflow self-test
''',
    '''      - name: Project Truth Compiler self-test
        run: python scripts/selftest_project_truth_compiler.py

      - name: Verify mode is read-only
        shell: bash
        run: |
          expected="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          base="$(python -c 'import json; print(json.load(open(".workflow/state.json", encoding="utf-8"))["last_accepted_sha"])')"
          python scripts/governance_engine.py --root . --base "$base" --mode verify --expected-head "$expected"
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- PROJECT_PROFILE.yaml .workflow docs artifacts/sequence scripts)"

      - name: STRICT workflow self-test
''',
)

print("SW2_02_SEQUENCE_READONLY_PATCH=APPLIED")
